title: US Agencies Warn of Cyberattacks on Refrigeration Systems
excerpt: United States government agencies warn that threat actors are targeting industrial refrigeration systems globally, risking fires and inventory loss.
body_html:
United States government agencies have issued a warning regarding active cyber threats targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems around the world. According to the alert, malicious actors are focusing on these systems to cause service disruptions, inventory losses, and fire hazards.

Investigators found that attackers may take advantage of weaknesses or unpatched vulnerabilities in internet-accessible controllers. By exploiting these entry points, threat actors can remotely modify settings and force units into continuous heating states.
